reviews.title: Punished for using their GTS
reviews.text:
I received two Pokémon through Pokémon HOME’s official GTS, only to discover that the same system now refuses to let me trade them. Support confirmed that altered game data was detected, but offered no solution, despite the fact that HOME itself allowed both trades.

The worst part? When I continued asking for help, Pokémon Support threatened to revoke my ability to contact support in the future.

So their trading system lets you receive Pokémon it considers invalid, leaves you stuck with them, and threatens to cut off support when you complain. Absolutely unacceptable for a service people pay for.

reviews.title: Consistent Crashing
reviews.text: I have been using the app since launch. I had encountered an issue in which the app would crash repeatedly when loading after the start screen. If there was a competent customer support team then they were impossible to reach. After repeated emails in which I kept getting the same pre written responses and days of no help they finally acknowledged that the app isn’t compatible with all devices and compatibility isn’t guaranteed. I have an iPhone 13 mini and the latest OS. Finally after days of back and forth with what I can only assume were bots I received no confirmation of there being an issue or that this was something that was going to be resolved or addressed. Highly frustrating experience especially coming from what should be a high quality app.

reviews.title: This app is perfect for storing pokemon
reviews.text: This app is so great for keeping all your pokemon secure in one app, so if your device ever breaks your Pokemon in there will be there still. And I love the trading options it makes trading more manageable. The only complaint is how you can’t really do anything with the Pokemon in there, I don’t want anything too advanced but maybe a few Go-styled interactions would make it more charming. But the missions in there are a real pain when some of them specifically ask for a deposit from a certain game, and since Bank is shutting down soon some of the missions that require pokemon from DS games need to be CHANGED! You shouldn’t require a Pokemon from a SPECIFIC game just to get the sticker and decorations, the Pokemon in general is what should get the sticker instead. And also the trading is absolutely terrible. Everyone asks for the same Pokemon it turns one trade for one Pokemon into literal hours of finding a match.

reviews.title: Been locked out of my account for over a week
reviews.text:
Title sums up a lot of it. I used an old Nintendo Switch to move some Pokemon over to Home. They were obviously legit as Home in its defence is solid at blocking dodgy Pokemon being sent from Switch games to Home these days



Whatever reason using an ooold switch to move Pokemon to my new one caused me to get stuck with an error permanently saying I’m logged in on another device, even when I’m clearly not as it effects the 2 Switches and mobile app and they’re the entire 3 devices logged in.


This was over a week ago, still happening. This adds on to the big fail they had not too long ago where friend trades glitched out and you sometimes lost Pokemon, followed by friend trades being down for a couple of weeks.


I’m on a now regular basis paying for a service which has failed twice for now not far off a month. No refunds or anything basic offered as “compensation” for their service regularly being useless. They didn’t even apologise or anything when friend trades glitched out, provided zero updates to users. Even the error message you got when you tried to friend trade “you can’t trade from this account” or something to that effect, which makes it more sound like people had somehow been banned.

reviews.title: Ridiculously sadistic design.
reviews.text: This app is pointless on anything other than a switch. Sure they offer special pokemon if you transfer every single available pokemon at each step of their evolution progression from a specific game, but that ruins the entire fun of the game. This app can connect to the games, you shouldn’t have to transfer every single available pokemon at every stage of evolution just so it recognizes that you did it, & it shouldn’t be specific to the game. Not only that but the dex looks completely different from the switch version, so even if the switch says you completed it, this app say “nah bruh lol, you still have to transfer the 900 others just to get the reward lol”. The space is limited, & some pokemon can’t even be transferred, so this just takes ages unless you meticulously build a living dex specific to the specific game, & pay them money to get more room. That’s on top of having to own both versions of the game just to get access to all the available pokemon. I don’t know who thinks up these ridiculously sadistic mechanics, but I know they definitely shouldn’t have a job.

reviews.title: 1 star until HOME refunds my two Eternal Flower Floettes
reviews.text: There is no prevention in trading rare pokemon, and there is no limitation on listing illegal trades either that are impossible to complete. No buffer if you accidentally submit the wrong offer to GTS, so trades happen instantly without any warning signs. There’s no reason why there should be no warning window when trading an Eternal Flower for a regular form Floette. HOME lost me two Eternal Flowers due to their poor design and lack of appropriate measures like GO to stop you from losing precious Pokemon. This is supposed to be a bank, where a bank allows your life savings to be given away for FREE in milliseconds. I deserve my two Eternal Flower Floettes that HOME stole from me. You did this. This is not my fault. Refund or permanent 1/5.
